name: pydegensac
description: Advanced RANSAC (DEGENSAC) with bells and whistles for H and F estimation

latest_release.name: Speed optimizations.
latest_release.body: ## 1.2-2x faster than 0.3.0, same output - GIL released during estimation; thread-safety fixes in the degeneracy RNG and table init - Faster fixed-size solvers and degeneracy recovery, fewer allocations, pooled LO hash nodes - AVX kernels picked at run time on x86, bit-identical to the scalar path (`PYDEGENSAC_SIMD=0` forces scalar) - Windows wheels use thread-safe OpenBLAS, so concurrent calls are safe - Examples switched from AKAZE to SIFT so they run on OpenCV 5
